name: Sushi Draft
summary: Simultaneous card-drafting set-collection game where players eat sushi to win hidden point chips for majorities and variety.
rules_text: Game is 3 rounds. Sort scoring chips into 6 facedown piles by type (5 sushi types + dessert). Each round shuffle 32 sushi cards (8/7/6/5/4 of types plus 2 wilds) and deal 6 face down to each player; remainder unused. All players act simultaneously. Each turn: 1) Choose 1 card from hand to eat, place facedown. 2) Reveal eaten cards simultaneously. Wilds must be declared as a copy of a type you already ate this round before reveal and placed on that card. 3) Choose 1 card to keep face down. 4) Pass remaining cards left; they join the kept card to form new hand. Repeat until 1 card remains per player, which is discarded, so 5 cards eaten. Scoring: For each sushi type, player who ate most of that type takes top chip from that pile; for dessert, player who ate most distinct types takes top dessert chip. Ties: chip goes to next player clockwise among tied players until untied; if all tied for a type, no chip awarded. Chips values kept facedown until final total. Most points after 3 rounds wins.
rating_reason: Sushi set-collection drafting, sequential pick, set scoring, no board needed.
